subject.title: [Bug]: Generic channel QA evidence overstates primary coverage

question: Should QA maturity evidence treat a scenario as primary coverage only when that scenario executes assertions for the exact taxonomy feature, with contextual channel or subagent behavior retained as secondary coverage?
rationale: The reported defect turns on the repository’s evidence-ownership policy, not merely a mechanical YAML edit; maintainers need to confirm the boundary before accepting the linked retargeting.

options.title: Adopt exact assertion ownership
options.body: Require primary coverage to map only to behavior directly exercised by the scenario and review the linked PR against that rule.

options.title: Allow broader primary attribution
options.body: Document the broader attribution rule and retain or revise the current mappings where contextual execution is intentionally sufficient.

recommendation.title: Adopt exact assertion ownership
recommendation.body: Require primary coverage to map only to behavior directly exercised by the scenario and review the linked PR against that rule.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete audit and the linked implementation proposal, making them the best available routing candidate for clarifying the intended mapping policy.
